exposure: Human Jelly Wharton's Stem Cell-Conditioned Medium (hJWSC-CM)
outcome: Number of testicular cells (spermatids, primary spermatocytes, spermatogonia, Leydig cells, Sertoli cells)
cohort: The study included 24 adult male mice divided into control, scrotal hyperthermia, scrotal hyperthermia + DMEM, and scrotal hyperthermia + conditioned medium groups.
finding: The conditioned medium (hJWSC-CM) significantly increased total sperm and testicular cell counts, improved testicular biochemical characteristics, increased Sox9 and proliferative gene expression, and decreased apoptotic and pro-inflammatory gene expression in hyperthermia-induced azoospermic mice.
